verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail claims some background automation: AI summaries and automatic labels on incoming mail, junk-mail filtering, and API integrations that keep documents and mail in sync with other tools. None of this shows users building their own autonomous automations, such as custom rules, triggers or workflows. missing for 10: user-configurable automation rules/triggers, documentation of how background workflows are set up and run, scheduled or event-driven actions (e.g., auto-forward/auto-export), independent or hands-on corroboration.
